mechanism.label: stable monotonic disclosed-constraint coverage ordering
mechanism.scope: Only reorder the already generated P5 category-evidence candidate list. Candidate generation, clarification, state updates, routing, and publication limits remain unchanged.
coverage_predicates: one predicate for an exact extracted active category match, when an active category exists
one predicate for each active color, style, material, or use-case constraint satisfied from catalog postings
one predicate for an active bounded-price constraint satisfied by at least one catalog price
one predicate for each distinct catalog feature/detail phrase present in the active current-intent evidence and satisfied by the candidate
ordering_algorithm: Start from the exact P5 deterministic candidate order.
Compute each candidate's integer active coverage count and existing explicit contradiction count without target labels.
Scan stably and move a candidate upward only across a predecessor when its coverage count is strictly greater and its contradiction count is no greater.
Repeat until no permitted inversion remains; preserve P5 order for equal coverage, greater-contradiction comparisons, and all incomparable pairs.
Apply the unchanged P5 weak-evidence anchor-floor publication step after ordering.
mechanism.disabled_behavior: With monotonic_constraint_coverage=false, responses and diagnostics must be byte-for-byte identical to P5.
mechanism.fallback_behavior: Any unavailable or malformed optional evidence contributes no predicate; the existing P5 ranking remains the deterministic fallback. No full-catalog response-time scan is introduced.

expected_affected_population.primary: runtime sessions with at least one strict disclosed-coverage inversion inside the existing bounded category-evidence list
expected_affected_population.expected_direction: promote candidates satisfying strictly more active disclosed constraints while preserving legitimate P5 priors among coverage ties

shadow_protocol.baseline: exact P5 under the same code with the new mechanism disabled
target_independent_proxies_required: malformed and missing optional metadata fallback

rejection_rule: Any failed gate rejects P7, retains P5, consumes no official run, and ends optimization without P8 or a switch to another residual family.
official_protocol: Only after every shadow and transfer gate passes, run one untouched official evaluation. Run the second and final evaluation only to confirm identical deterministic outcomes after a passing first run.
forbidden_inputs_and_changes: shadow or public target identifiers and labels at runtime
session identifiers, hidden scenario labels, and future turns as policy inputs
official evaluator, public dataset, simulator, metric, targets, stopping behavior, P3 exposure, or confidence gating
